snippet.title: BlueBirdRP Update - July
snippet.description:
🔥 July Update – BlueBirdRP | Massive New Content Drop 🔥

This month’s update brings huge changes to BlueBirdRP – from brand-new crafting and territory mechanics, to player-owned businesses, truck logistics, heists, lumberjacking, medic and fire upgrades, and more!

This video covers some of the highlights, but there’s even more waiting for you in the city. For the full changelog, head to our #change-logs channel in Discord or check out the community conversation around this month’s changes.

⚠️ Some features (like the new Lumber and Heist systems) will be tested in controlled access first – stay tuned for updates and report any issues via Discord.

💬 Join the community:
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/bluebirdrp
📷 Instagram: @scaraustralian
🐦 Twitter/X: @scaraustralian
🎥 Twitch: ScarAus on Twitch
📘 Threads: @scaraustralian
🌐 Website: https://bbrp.live

If you enjoy the update, don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more BlueBirdRP content, dev updates, and sneak peeks at what’s coming next!

#FiveM #GTA5RP #BlueBirdRP #Roleplay #GTAUpdate #JulyPatch
